This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The land belonging to the petitioner bearing Sy.No.260/5 measuring 04 guntas situated at Gangavathi Town, Gangavathi Taluk, Koppal District, was acquired for the purpose of construction of railway line between Munirabad - Mehaboob Nagar, by issuing a notification under Section 4(1)
of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 culminating in passing an award under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.
Under the said award, the compensation was determined at Rs.506/- per sq. feet with all statutory benefits.

2. The petitioner's grievance is that the award under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act was passed on 6.5.2002, however, the beneficiary i.e. the respondent No.2 has not deposited the compensation amount.

3. Therefore, it is expedient to dispose of the writ petition directing the respondent No.2 to implement the award dated 6.5.2022 in No.Kandaya/Bhu Swa/02/2009-10 passed by the respondent No.1 approved on 10.5.2022 by the Deputy Commissioner concerned within eight weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, if not already implemented with all statutory benefits.

Sd/-
